tools.name: custom SKILL.md 'inbox review' skill
tools.detail: Phase 1: Fetch and Triage Emails (buckets: Auto-archive, Needs Tunde's response ...), Phase 2: Auto-Archive and Report; triggered by typing 'email please'

claims: Every morning he types 'email please' and Claude fetches ~20 days of inbox via Gmail MCP and writes a summary file
The file lists each email needing a reply (subject + summary) with a blank 'YOUR RESPONSE:' line; he types rough intents like 'no', 'please', 'maybe next time'
On 'send to gmail draft' Claude calls gmail_create_draft for each and the drafts appear in Gmail for review before sending
Part 4 of a 'Craziest use case of Claude' series
how_to_steps: Connect the claude.ai Gmail MCP connector to Claude Code (MCP servers panel)
Write a SKILL.md with Phase 1 (fetch last ~20 days, triage into buckets: auto-archive / needs response / etc.) and Phase 2 (auto-archive and report)
Type 'email please'; Claude writes inbox-review.txt with each email's subject, summary, and a 'YOUR RESPONSE:' slot
Open the file, type a one-line intent under each email (e.g. 'no sorry not interested')
Tell Claude 'send to gmail draft'; it creates a Gmail draft per email via gmail_create_draft
Review drafts in Gmail (filter Drafts) and send
on_screen_only: MCP servers panel: claude.ai Gmail / claude.ai Google Calendar / claude.ai (How It Grow?) / claude.ai Notion, each 'Connected'

SKILL.md headers: '## Phase 1: Fetch and Triage Emails', '### Bucket A: Auto-archive (no response needed)', '### Bucket B: Needs Tunde's response', 'Important: When in doubt, put it in Bucket B', '## Phase 2: Auto-Archive and Report'
Claude run log: 'Starting Phase 1 - fetching your inbox emails from the last 20 days', 'Claude AI Gmail [gmail_search_messages]'

inbox-review.txt: '5 emails need your response. Write a quick note under each one telling me how you want to respond, then let me know when you're done.' with items like 'SUBJECT: Potential Partnership Opportunity with DealMirror', 'SUBJECT: Tunde Alao collab w/ ZWO', 'Upfluence is pitching you for a campaign with ZWO'
Prompt typed: 'send to gmail draft'; tool calls 'Claude AI Gmail [gmail_create_draft]' with draft IDs
Gmail drafts list: SendGrid, Wahab, Upfluence, Pratyush drafts
Overlay: 'Craziest use case of Claude - Part 4'
cta: comment 'CC' to get a link to the skill

relevance.why: Email triage is a daily time sink; the annotate-a-file-then-batch-draft loop is a clean human-in-the-loop pattern for a time-poor founder and uses only the first-party Gmail connector.

implement_score.why: Haji already runs a haji-email skill with its own triage/draft/approval gate, so this is an incremental idea: add a 'review file with one-line intents' step so all replies are decided in one pass. An hour to fold in; the skill itself is not shared (comment-gated).

gap.what: The liked set covers email agents (Town, Jarvis reading Gmail) but not this specific technique: a two-phase skill that dumps triage into a text file, lets you annotate intents in bulk, then batch-creates Gmail drafts via the first-party Gmail MCP.
